components.name: Primary Draw Button
components.description: High-contrast action for advancing the draw.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-primary" type="button">หมุนหลักถัดไป</button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--green-dark); color: #fff; font: 600 12px/1.2 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #07452a; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #83c89a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action alongside the primary draw control.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-quiet" type="button">เริ่มรอบใหม่</button>
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #b6c1b5; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 600 12px/1.2 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-button-quiet:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #f7faf5; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-quiet:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #83c89a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-quiet:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Import Button
components.description: Full-width outlined action in the import form.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-outline" type="button">นำเข้ารายชื่อ</button>
components.css: .ds-button-outline { width: 100%; min-height: 38px; margin-top: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--green-dark); background: transparent; color: var(--green-dark); font: 600 12px/1.2 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-button-outline:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #e5f0e4; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-outline:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #83c89a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-outline:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-search-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 49px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #b8c1b5; border-radius: 0; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.2 var(--sans); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #8a948b; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #83c89a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Entry Count Chip
components.description: Compact outlined count beside the entry-list heading.
components.css: .ds-count-chip { display: inline-flex; min-width: 23px; height: 22px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 5px; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink-soft); font: 500 10px/1 var(--mono); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Text navigation with a green underline on the selected view.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav-item ds-is-active" type="button">วงล้อจับรางวัล</button>
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; padding: 2px 0 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #5f6b62; font: 400 13px/1.2 var(--sans); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 3px; background: transparent; content: ""; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item.ds-is-active { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-item.ds-is-active { font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-item.ds-is-active::after { background: var(--green); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #83c89a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Six fixed digit positions on a paper ticket surface.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-ticket { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 26px 28px 14px; border: 1px solid #cbd2c7; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgb(35 58 43 / 7%); } .ds-perforation { position: absolute; top: 15px; right: 15px; width: 29px; height: 1px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #b9c1b5 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); } .ds-digit-track { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-digit-cell { min-width: 0; padding: 9px 7px 12px; text-align: center; border-right: 1px dashed #cdd2c9; } .ds-digit-cell:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-digit-cell small { display: block; min-height: 19px; margin-bottom: 2px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 10px/1.2 var(--sans); } .ds-digit-cell strong { display: block; color: #aeb7ad; font: 400 clamp(29px, 4.4vw, 49px)/1.22 var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ticket-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding-top: 11px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 10px/1.2 var(--sans); } .ds-ticket-footer strong { color: var(--green-dark); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Excel File Drop
components.description: Dashed upload target with the project’s inline upload glyph.
components.css: .ds-file-drop { position: relative; min-height: 126px; display: grid; justify-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 4px; padding: 13px; border: 1px dashed #aebcaf; background: rgb(255 254 250 / 60%); color: var(--ink); text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s ease, background .2s ease; } .ds-file-drop:hover { border-color: var(--green); background: #f9fcf7; } .ds-file-drop svg { width: 25px; height: 25px; margin-bottom: 3px; color: var(--green); } .ds-file-drop strong { font: 600 11px/1.2 var(--sans); } .ds-file-drop span { color: var(--muted); font: 400 9px/1.2 var(--sans); } .ds-file-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; clip-path: inset(50%); } .ds-file-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #83c89a; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: ตั๋วและกระดานสด
narrative.overview:
The six-digit draw uses a segmented result ticket beside a fixed-order participant board. Warm paper tones, dark green print, perforation-like rules, and tabular numerals carry the ticket-and-live-board direction into a practical Thai-language interface.

The visual language keeps each digit place visible as the draw advances. Green marks drawn and matching positions, while quiet rules and paper surfaces keep names, entries, and controls legible. The same system supports the draw, exact-name lookup, and saved results without making the interface copy read like a travel document.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces and forest-green actions or match states.
Six equal, fixed-order digit positions with tabular numerals.
Square panels, fine rules, and restrained ticket perforation details.
Thai interface labels with a Thai sans-serif and a distinct numeric mono face.

rules.name: The Green Match Rule
rules.body: Use the green family for active progress and matching digits so the state reads consistently across the ticket and participant board.

rules.name: The Place-Value Rule
rules.body: Keep lottery digits in the mono face with tabular alignment so a position stays easy to compare as the draw progresses.

rules.name: The Fixed-Place Rule
rules.body: A match changes color and emphasis inside its existing digit cell; it does not move the number or reorder the participant row.

dos: Do keep all six digit places visible in their fixed order.
Do highlight matching digits in place with the green match treatment.
Do keep number strings in the tabular mono face, including leading zeroes.
Do let paper surfaces and fine rules carry most of the layout structure.
donts: Don't move or reorder participant rows as matches arrive.
Don't round the main ticket, buttons, inputs, or data panels.
Don't add literal travel terminology to product copy; the ticket geometry carries the chosen metaphor.
